title: Harmonic heights and the Artin K(pi,1) conjecture
summary: We prove that the standard Salvetti complex of every Artin group with finitely many standard generators is aspherical. This resolves the Artin $`K(\pi,1)`$ conjecture in finite rank.
family_title: Classifying spaces and geometric obstructions for Artin groups

review.reason: Proves asphericity of Salvetti complexes for finite-rank Artin groups, resolving the K(π,1) conjecture.
